school.name: PS 331
school.overview:
P.S. 331 is a new elementary school opening in September 2024 starting with kindergarten. Our school is a nurturing and inclusive learning environment where we firmly believe that every student can and will acquire the essential skills necessary for success in life. Our commitment is to foster 21st-century global citizens, empowering graduates with a profound understanding of entrepreneurial pathways, sensible financial knowledge, and proficiency in strong communication and technology skills with a dedicated focus on a world language.
For more information about this school, please visit schools.nyc.gov/K. P.S. 331 is a new elementary school opened in September 2024 accepting kindergarten in school year 2024-2025.
